## Problem and change

Why is this needed? Link the issue and upstream sources.

## Validation

Build/configuration checks and results. Hardware evidence: device/panel variant, stock build,
kernel release/commit, integration commit or image identity, steps, results and sanitized logs.

## Untested or limited

What remains untested? Include behavior with optional hardware absent or failing if affected.

## Sources and documentation

Imported sources/licenses and local changes; documentation updated or reason none is needed.
